title: Existence of a sheafified balanced tensor extension
statement: Fix R,P,H and a tensor presheaf B as in [def-sfb-condensed-tensor-induction-data], with sheafification data D. For every H-equivariant morphism f:M to Res_H^P(N), there exists a P-equivariant internal-module map F:D.functor(M) to N such that F(eta([p] tensor m))=p f(m) for every profinite S, p in C(S,P), and m in M(S). This is existence only; no uniqueness, inverse identities, or naturality is assumed.

source.place: Agent-formulated induction argument below paragraph (3); Existence of a sheafified balanced tensor extension. External reference WANTED, as for the parent.

proof.text: On finite sums send a[p] tensor m to a times p f(m). Linearity kills the additive and scalar relations, and H-equivariance of f kills balancing, since (ph)f(m)=p f(hm). Thus this descends to each concrete quotient. The restriction formula and naturality make it a presheaf map, and left multiplication makes it P-equivariant.

Apply the ordinary module-sheafification Hom equivalence to the balanced natural map. Transport across D.comparison and full faithfulness of the section-module equivalence. On the sheafification unit the resulting internal morphism is the original presheaf map. To prove P-equivariance on an arbitrary sheaf section x, cover by local preimages of x along that unit. Restrict the group element as well. Naturality of the action and morphism, D.induced_action, and presheaf equivariance prove equality on this cover; separatedness of the target sheaf proves equality globally. The unit formula gives the required pure-tensor normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorInductionExtension_exists (B : TensorInductionPresheaf R P H)
    (D : TensorInductionSheafData B) (M : ActionModule R H.toSubgroup)
    (N : ActionModule R P)
    (f : M ⟶ (inflate (inductionSubgroupInclusion P H)).obj N) :
    ∃ F : D.functor.obj M ⟶ N,
      ∀ (S : Profinite.{u}) (p : C(S, P)) (m : sectionModule R M.module S),
        ((F.val.hom.hom.app (op S)).hom)
            (B.sheafTensor D.functor D.comparison M S p m) =
          N.act S p ((f.val.hom.hom.app (op S)).hom m)
